read.en: SpaceX fell 1.7% on Oct 16 to $146.03 after an intraday low of $142.96; with 88 sessions of history it has no 100 or 200-day averages yet. It is below its falling 5-day ($153.35), rising 30-day ($153.44) and 10-day ($160.05) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($174.5), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月16日盘中低见 $142.96，收盘下跌 1.7%，报 $146.03；上市仅 88 个交易日，尚无 100 日和 200 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$153.35）、上行的 30 日（$153.44）和 10 日均线（$160.05）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$174.5），RSI 为 43。

read.en: For a second day the low undercut the $145.4 Sep 28 low and the close held above it. Resistance is $153.4 (5 and 30-day averages), then $160 (10-day) and $174.5–176.4 (SAR, Oct 6 high). Support is $145.4, then $140.7 (Oct 15 low) and $130.4 (Aug 20 low). A close below $140.7 would open $130.4; a close above $153.4 would target $160.
read.zh: 盘中低点连续第二日跌破 $145.4 的 9月28日低点，收盘仍守在其上方。阻力为 $153.4（5 日和 30 日均线），其次 $160（10 日均线）和 $174.5–176.4（SAR、10月6日高点）。支撑为 $145.4，其次 $140.7（10月15日低点）和 $130.4（8月20日低点）。若收盘跌破 $140.7，下一目标看 $130.4；若收盘站上 $153.4，目标看 $160。
